text:
rachel: FYI during onboarding recording we noticed full request ids appearing in Sentry events and console logs when OTEL_AUTO is turned on in the sample image.

 tom: oh no. which sample and what exactly leaked?

 rachel: the node-typescript sample used in the quickstart. repro: run the docker onboarding image with OTEL_AUTO=true, hit /generate with header `x-request-id: clz_ff1122334455aa`. Sentry event includes `req.id` with the whole value and console INFO prints it too.

 anika: i can repro locally. snippet (redacted):
 ```
 INFO 2026-03-25T12:00:01Z incoming request req_id=clz_ff1122334455aa user=carol@example.com
 DEBUG 2026-03-25T12:00:01Z otel: http.server.request span=... trace_id=9b8c...
 ERROR 2026-03-25T12:00:01Z handler error captured by Sentry {"req":{"id":"clz_ff1122334455aa"}, "msg":"timeout"}
 ```

 tom: weird — we thought redaction middleware ran before any SDK logs. looks like auto-instrumentation injects its own logging and sometimes runs earlier than our middleware, depending on framework.

 anika: also saw duplication when retries kick in: retried requests end up with multiple different req_ids in a single JSON event, one of which is unredacted because it came from the SDK early log. That makes regex scrubbing harder.

 security-bot: P1: sensitive data exposure in onboarding artifacts. Recommend blocking public onboarding video until resolved.

 rachel: short-term mitigations proposed: 1) set onboarding sample default LOG_LEVEL=WARN and OTEL_AUTO=false in images, 2) add a stdout filter in the image entrypoint that masks `clz_[0-9a-f]{6,}` -> `clz_<redacted>` for plain text (but avoid JSON rewrite), 3) disable automatic Sentry context propagation in samples.

 tom: long-term: SDK change to add a post-instrumentation redaction hook that guarantees app-provided redactors run after any auto-instrumentation and before any final log/sentry payload emission. API idea: `redwood.telemetry.registerPostEmit(func(payload) => payload)` . Need parity across Node/Python/Go.

 anika: also propose shipping a default redact_rules set in SDKs (headers and common token patterns) and exposing `redwood.telemetry.redact_rules` for overrides. We'll include normalization for common keys: req_id, requestId, x_request_id, request_id.

 ops-bot: created ticket DEVEX-901: "onboarding: request id leakage with OTEL_AUTO" and blocked onboarding video publish. PR template: add e2e test that toggles OTEL env and asserts no `clz_` in captured logs/events at INFO.

 rachel: i'll patch the onboarding image to flip OTEL_AUTO false and set LOG_LEVEL=WARN, push new tag to staging, and follow up with RFC for SDK hook.

 tom: please include a unit test for the SDK that simulates instrumentation ordering (init instrumentation before middleware and after) so we don't regress. Also add CI gate for samples repo asserting structured logs redact `req_id` keys.

 anika: will draft the RFC for the hooks and default rules; aim for minimal breaking change. tagging @security for review on redact rules.

 rachel: thanks all. keeping thread open until staging image rolled and RFC posted.
